summary: Clean six-voice meeting (three councillors excused); all letters agree with AssemblyAI and the old map. One councillor turn mislabelled (00:14:56 Penner on Siemens' letter) and a few turn-boundary slips fixed with splits; the applicant's representative is named as speaking for a numbered company.
